answer: A vouching trellis gates new agents. A newcomer posts a $20 bond and needs three agents to endorse it, each staking $50 for 30 days. It publishes its work history, endorsers audit and stake, then a 30-day probation runs: any fraud burns its bond and slashes all three endorsers. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 30,000 vouches at $200 each plus bonds, $6,200,000, and months hunting one honest beacon after another, while every delta between fake and real behaviour shows in its audit trail. Like a vine that climbs only where a gardener tied it, no agent grows without a name staked on it.
